title: AI Assistant

history.title: Chats
history.empty: No chats yet. Your questions are kept here, newest first.

clearConsequence: Only the record on this phone is deleted
empty: Ask how the router is doing, which devices are online or how the Wi-Fi is set up. It can also make changes for you, such as blocking a device; it always asks you first.
suggestions: Is the Wi-Fi channel a good one?
Any devices with a weak signal?
demoNote: Demo mode: answers come from a script built into the app, offline.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.body: Your questions and the router data the app looks up go to the AI provider you chose ({{provider}}), which writes the answers. That data: router status, the device list (names, IP and MAC addresses), Wi-Fi and firewall settings, and the system log.
consent.privacy: MAC addresses and public IP addresses are masked by default, and each kind of data can be switched off in the settings. Passwords and keys are never sent.
consent.writes: Before changing anything on the router, the AI asks you in the conversation.

confirm.title: The AI wants to make a change
confirm.reboot_router: Restart the router. Every device loses its connection for a minute or two.
confirm.kick_device: Disconnect {{device}} from Wi-Fi; it may reconnect at once.
confirm.block_device: Block internet access for {{device}} (the local network still works).
confirm.set_wifi: Change the Wi-Fi "{{ssid}}": {{changes}}. Devices on it drop off for a moment.
confirm.set_radio_off: Switch radio {{radio}} off; all its Wi-Fi networks go down.

error.no-key: Add an API key in the settings first
error.auth: The API key is invalid or has expired
error.quota: Out of credit, or a spending limit was reached
error.rate: Too many requests; try again shortly
error.overloaded: The provider is busy; try again shortly

setup.modelHint: After testing the connection you can pick from the provider's list
setup.apiKeyHint: Kept only in this phone's keychain
setup.privacyFooter: What you switch off is not sent to the provider; the AI may then be unable to answer some questions. Passwords and keys are never sent.
setup.mask: Mask MAC Addresses and Public IPs
setup.maskHint: Only the maker part of a MAC and the first half of a public IP are sent
setup.historyFooter: Kept on this phone, separately for each router. Find, rename or delete them in the assistant's chat history.
